notes.title: Permanent -50% price reduction
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.
In order to push up sales of 'Vugluskr: zombie rampage' game and help me with next game development - I decided to permanently reduce retail price by 50% on average (some regional prices may vary, but overall trend are same).
I hope existing game owners will understand that move - I need to purchase a few Unreal Engine 4 plugins and assets at Unreal Marketplace to speed up the next game production pipeline.
I will not plan any further price cuts in the future so far - after Steam fees, taxes, and refunds, profitability under question :).

Thank you.
Sergey R.
